title: Brazil's constitution says habeas corpus shall be granted against illegal or abusive restraint of movement
summary: Brazil's constitution says habeas corpus shall be granted against illegal or abusive restraint of movement.
body: The constitution's English text says habeas corpus shall be granted whenever a person suffers or is threatened with violence or coercion against freedom of movement through illegality or abuse of power. The source says: "justified restraint habeas corpus shall be granted whenever a person suffers or is threatened with suffering violence or coercion in his freedom of movement through illegality or abuse of power; Right to amparo , Ultra-vires administrative actions a writ of security (mandado de segurança) shall be issued to protect a liquid and certain right not protected by habeas corpus or habeas data, when the party responsible for the illegality or abuse of power is a public authority or an agent of a le" The writ is tied to freedom of movement and to illegality or abuse of power. Other remedies in the same catalogue are not this sentence.
